knownIssues.symptom: Does not start without a launch option.
knownIssues.cause: not established. The reporter had to force the Direct3D 11 renderer.
knownIssues.fix: add -d3d11 to the game's launch options in Steam.

title: Satisfactory
provenance: Reported by lmcropper (highball-db#190, 2026-09-23), Apple M5, macOS 26.6.2, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after about 90 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. Second report by dlueder (highball-db#325, 2026-10-05), Apple M4 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, the environment in DXVK mode, rated 4 of 5 after 127 minutes, the minor issues not described. Third report by mrdoge2008 (highball-db#346, 2026-10-05), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, the report naming Wine's own Direct3D while the environment was on DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 45 minutes. Fourth report by Luspuz (highball-db#431, 2026-10-10), Apple M4, macOS 15.7.4, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after 11 minutes. Fourth report by Flix-29 (highball-db#659, 2026-10-24), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, played on D3DMetal with the environment in DXMT mode, rated 5 of 5 after 53 minutes.
notes: Reported perfect on D3DMetal on an M5 after about 90 minutes, at 40 to 60 fps at 1080p on Low settings. The reporter had to add -d3d11 to the game's Steam launch options. Nothing was measured here. A second player put over two hours into it on an M4 Max with the environment in DXVK mode and rated it playable with minor issues they did not describe, so the game runs on DXVK as well as on D3DMetal; the report does not say whether -d3d11 was needed there. A third player on an M4 played 45 minutes; the frame rate was rough at first and smooth once the Mac had warmed up, which fits shaders being compiled during the first minutes. A player on an M4 with macOS 15 also rated it perfect on D3DMetal. A fourth player rated it perfect on an M4 over 53 minutes on D3DMetal (highball-db#659).
